listings.name: MECAD
listings.current_description: MECAD Systems is South Africa's longest-standing SOLIDWORKS partner, with 35 years of experience providing SOLIDWORKS and 3DEXPERIENCE Works licensing, CAD/CAM integration, consulting, training and technical support, while its sister company MECAD Manufacturing is the sole reseller of Mastercam for Sub-Saharan Africa.

listings.name: MH Marketing Management
listings.current_description: MH Marketing Management, founded in 2020 and previously known as MJH Marketing, draws on more than eight years of experience in the marketing and automotive industries to connect automotive brands with marketing professionals, managing everything from campaign planning to reporting and claims.

listings.name: Mitsubishi
listings.current_description: CMH Mitsubishi Menlyn is a new and pre-owned Mitsubishi dealership in Menlyn, part of the Combined Motor Holdings group, and has won the Dealer of the Year award in the Service After Sales category at the Mitsubishi Motors South Africa Annual Awards.

listings.name: Mokhine Group (Pty) Ltd
listings.current_description: Mokhine Group (Pty) Ltd, based in Garsfontein, Pretoria East, is a construction and facilities-management turnkey solutions provider that began as a small civil construction contractor in 2007, specialising in retaining walls, road, tunnel and railway construction, and hospital engineering and construction works.

listings.name: Montana Granite Tombstones Pretoria
listings.current_description: Montana Granite Tombstones Pretoria, founded in 1984 in Booysens, is a manufacturer and supplier of granite and marble tombstones across Gauteng, offering budget, standard, executive, double and children's headstones with a patented fastening method, with lettering and installation included in the price.

listings.name: Mpresif Marketing & Consulting
listings.current_description: Mpresif Marketing & Consulting is a Wonderboom South-based marketing consultancy that runs workshops covering topics from social media to basic marketing principles, alongside strategic marketing plans, content writing and graphic design aimed at helping small and medium businesses market themselves more effectively.

listings.name: MTD Research Specialists
listings.current_description: MTD Research Specialists is a socio-economic research firm founded in 2009 that provides feasibility studies, market intelligence, economic research and trade policy studies, valuation and due-diligence work, survey design, and data capturing, analysis and report-writing services for public, private and voluntary-sector clients.

listings.name: Myfamily projects and consulting
listings.current_description: Myfamily Projects and Consulting is a management consulting and skills development firm in Heatherview, Pretoria, established in 2013 and accredited by QCTO and Services SETA, specialising in project management, business development and training services for organisations in the private and public sectors.

listings.name: Ndabase Printing Solutions
listings.current_description: Ndabase Printing Solutions is a 100% black-owned, Level 1 B-BBEE printing company established in 2007, offering litho, digital and wide-format printing along with finishing services such as lamination, UV varnishing, die cutting, folding and embossing from its Kosmosdal Samrand Business Park facility.

listings.name: NJW Engineering
listings.current_description: NJW Engineering is a structural steelwork company established in 2007 in Rosslyn, offering structural steel design, fabrication and erection along with cold-formed lipped channel rolling from a 4,000m2 workshop served by six overhead cranes, for office, commercial, industrial and mining projects.

listings.name: Palms Guest House
listings.current_description: Palms Guest House in Eloffsdal is a 3-star bed and breakfast offering 14 luxury double and single rooms, five family and self-catering units, and a honeymoon suite with a kitchenette and Jacuzzi. It also hosts corporate functions, conferences, weddings and other celebrations.

listings.name: Platinum Iris Rhenosterfontein Depot
listings.current_description: Platinum Iris Rhenosterfontein Depot is a depot of Platinum Iris, a petroleum industry company founded in 2014, operating from Rhenosterfontein Road in Donkerhoek. It trades Monday to Friday from 07:00 to 17:00 and Saturday from 07:00 to 14:00.

listings.name: Prosperitas Personnel
listings.current_description: Prosperitas Personnel is a recruitment agency based in Wierdapark with 25 years of specialist experience placing candidates in finance, engineering, medical, supply chain and IT roles, including C-level and executive search assignments across South Africa, the rest of Africa and the UAE.

listings.name: PSG Silver Lakes Wealth Management & Stockbroking
listings.current_description: PSG Silver Lakes Wealth Management & Stockbroking is a financial and fiduciary advisory office in Hazeldean Office Park, Silver Lakes, offering wealth management, stockbroking and estate planning services focused on the private client market as part of the PSG Financial Services group.

listings.name: PSI CRO South Africa
listings.current_description: PSI CRO South Africa is the local office of PSI CRO, a global Clinical Research Organization that conducts clinical trials and research work for pharmaceutical and biotech clients, based out of Highveld Techno Park in Centurion as part of PSI's international network.

listings.name: Quill Associates (Pty) Ltd
listings.current_description: Quill Associates is a 100% South African-owned IT business software company established in Pretoria in 1988. It developed the BIQ business performance system, first implemented at Brits Municipality in 1994 and still used by municipal councils across South Africa, Zimbabwe and Namibia.

listings.name: RAM Centurion
listings.current_description: RAM Centurion is a courier hub of RAM Hand-to-Hand Couriers, part of a national network of 41 hubs across Southern Africa with over 1,474 vehicles and more than 2,800 trained personnel; the company states it never subcontracts a single delivery.

listings.name: REGENT Business School - Pretoria
listings.current_description: REGENT Business School's Pretoria campus, in Hillcrest Office Park, belongs to a private higher-education institution established in 1998 as a post-apartheid empowerment institution and now part of the Honoris United Universities network, offering certificates, diplomas, degrees, honours, masters and doctoral (DBA) qualifications.

listings.name: Rubrix Community Living Administrators
listings.current_description: Rubrix Community Living Administrators is a managing agent providing sectional title and community scheme management, including financial administration, legal compliance, maintenance guidance, AGM coordination and trustee support. The company is registered with the PPRA and the National Association of Managing Agents (NAMA).

listings.name: Rylo Industrial Solutions
listings.current_description: Rylo Industrial Solutions supplies industrial and commercial equipment including compressors, generators, pumps and cleaning machinery, alongside in-house formulated cleaning chemicals. The company also undertakes custom installations such as car wash systems and shade structures, plus equipment servicing and repairs, with nationwide delivery.

listings.name: Samrand Panel Beaters
listings.current_description: Samrand Panel Beaters is an auto body repair shop specialising in dent, scratch and hail damage repairs, panel replacement and spray painting, with an in-house paint-matching facility and mobile paintless dent removal, and works with insurers including Miway, M-Sure and Wesbank Fleet.

listings.name: SEESA (Pty) Ltd
listings.current_description: SEESA (Pty) Ltd is a labour-law and compliance firm advising on employment contracts and terminations, disciplinary procedures and CCMA support, skills training and employment equity, occupational health and safety, BEE consulting, and payroll, UIF and Compensation Fund administration through its Connect platform.

listings.name: Simo’s coffee roastery
listings.current_description: Simo's Coffee Roastery has roasted coffee on demand at Karoo Square, Lynnwood Road since 2013, using a small-batch manual roaster and 100% Arabica beans from eight countries to produce five signature blends, sold alongside brewing equipment and coffee from an on-site shop.

listings.name: SL Consulting
listings.current_description: SL Consulting is a business consulting firm based in Glen Lauriston, Pretoria, specialising in drawing up building plans, submitting them to city council building offices for approval, and facilitating the construction phase, with over 28 years of experience working with Gauteng municipalities.

listings.name: SoReal Solutions
listings.current_description: SoReal Solutions is an IT support and cloud services provider in Highveld, Centurion, offering technical support with SLA-backed response times, cloud hosting, network design, cybersecurity, VoIP telephony, backup and disaster recovery, and Microsoft 365 services, with over 20 years in the industry.

listings.name: SSC Group
listings.current_description: SSC Group is a diversified company established in 2005, operating across mining, mining rehabilitation and exploration, drilling, advisory and human capital services, renewable energy, SMME development and digital agency work, and holds B-BBEE Level 1 status as a majority black-women owned enterprise.

listings.name: STC Ingco Concept Store (Silverton Tool Centre)
listings.current_description: STC Ingco Concept Store (Silverton Tool Centre) is a hardware and tool retailer in Silverton, Pretoria, stocking power tools, hand tools, gardening equipment and LP gas for tradespeople and DIY customers, and also offering key cutting, number plate and bicycle repair services.

listings.name: Supertec Ceilings & Drywall (Centurion)
listings.current_description: Supertec Ceilings and Drywall (Centurion) is the Rooihuiskraal branch of a national ceiling and drywall partitioning manufacturer and distributor, supplying ceiling systems, gypsum drywall partitions and acoustic ceiling solutions, and serving as an exclusive Rockfon distributor with brands including Gyproc and Knauf.

listings.name: T.Y.D. Construction
listings.current_description: T.Y.D. Construction is an NHBRC-registered building contractor based in Leeuwfontein, Pretoria, handling new home construction, extensions and renovations, and commercial and industrial projects such as office blocks and factories across Pretoria, Midrand, Cullinan, Bela-Bela and Brits, in business since 1993.

listings.name: Takelight Log Cabin Projects
listings.current_description: Takelight Log Cabin Projects is a timber-home builder in Pretoria North with over six years' experience and more than 136 completed projects, designing, constructing and renovating log cabins and Nutec homes from one to four bedrooms, using pre-existing or custom floor plans.

listings.name: TH-Vision (Business Development )
listings.current_description: TH-Vision is a business-development and ICT consulting firm near Zwavelpoort, Pretoria East, offering website and mobile-app development, graphic design and branding, and company-registration and compliance consulting, working with clients across Gauteng and into the Free State, Western Cape, Limpopo and North West.

listings.name: The Capital Menlyn Maine
listings.current_description: The Capital Menlyn Maine is a 5-star hotel in the Menlyn Maine precinct with 175 accommodations spanning standard and executive rooms, disability-friendly rooms, one-, two- and three-bedroom self-catering apartments, and two-bedroom penthouses, plus an outdoor pool, spa, conference centre and fitness facilities.

listings.name: The Croc Meat Company
listings.current_description: The Croc Meat Company is a wholesale butchery established in 2020 specialising in crocodile meat cuts and sausages, also stocking venison and other game meats, all processed at registered abattoirs, with delivery across Gauteng and bulk delivery to Durban and Cape Town.

listings.name: The Waste Group (Pty) Ltd
listings.current_description: The Waste Group (Pty) Ltd provides waste removal, recycling and landfill management for domestic, commercial, industrial and municipal clients across Gauteng and neighbouring provinces, including building rubble removal and hazardous waste handling, and operates private landfill sites at Bon Accord and Mooiplaats.

listings.name: TheBuyerSam
listings.current_description: TheBuyerSam supplies industrial steel and security fencing products, including Vista-Mesh security fencing and Sharp Metal Pressings items such as razor spikes, palisade and pool fencing, acting as an official agent for major South African steel manufacturers with services extending cross-border into Zimbabwe.

listings.name: Tremco
listings.current_description: Tremco is a roofing and painting contractor with over 30 years' experience, specialising in roof repairs, waterproofing and roof painting across tile, zinc, flat, concrete and metal roofs, plus interior and exterior paint contracting and damp-proofing, serving Pretoria, Centurion, Midrand and Johannesburg.

listings.name: Tswaing Meteorite Crater
listings.current_description: Tswaing Meteorite Crater is a Ditsong museum site around a well-preserved meteorite impact crater roughly 1.4km in diameter and 200m deep, formed about 220,000 years ago, offering a lookout point, hiking trails, birdwatching and guided tours of former salt-mine ruins.

listings.name: Ultimate Stationery (Pty) Ltd
listings.current_description: Ultimate Stationery (Pty) Ltd is an office supplies retailer in Hermanstad selling stationery, paper and printing products, office furniture, printer cartridges and back-to-school supplies both in-store and online, with free Gauteng delivery on orders over R300 and 30-day accounts for business customers.

listings.name: Universal Signs & Advertising
listings.current_description: Universal Signs & Advertising is a Koedoespoort signage and printing company established in the early 1970s, manufacturing safety signage, pylons, gates and fencing in-house alongside business-card and brochure printing, branded apparel and embroidery, and display products such as gazebos and roll-up banners.

listings.name: Vavro Plastics Cc
listings.current_description: Vavro Plastics is a Rosslyn manufacturer of custom PVC and polypropylene products established in 1960, producing ring binders, folders, document holders, travel wallets and packaging that can be branded with silkscreen printing, embossing or encapsulation for the promotional, printing and stationery industries.

listings.name: Wolff Logistics
listings.current_description: Wolff Logistics is a transport company trading since 1997, with a logistics division launched in 2010, offering truck rentals from 1 to 8 tons, commercial vehicle sales, and a workshop for truck repairs and maintenance across a fleet of over 300 trucks.

listings.name: World Link Consulting
listings.current_description: World Link Consulting is a SAP partner offering SAP ERP implementation and configuration, SAP Fiori and SAPUI5 mobile app development, RISE with SAP and S/4HANA Cloud migrations, and SAP Analytics Cloud reporting, serving government, mining, retail and oil & gas clients.

listings.name: Airbag Services
listings.current_description: Airbag Services, trading as Airbag Testing and Training (Pty) Ltd, has offered specialist OEM electronic airbag fitment and repair since 2003, and is the only company in South Africa offering non-destructive airbag testing to SABS ARP 068 standards and dedicated airbag training programmes.

listings.name: Alumo Energy - Solar Power Company Pretoria
listings.current_description: Alumo Energy is a solar engineering, procurement and construction company with its Pretoria branch in Nieuw Muckleneuk, part of a countrywide network of 7 branches offering solar panel installation, maintenance and battery back-up solutions with buy, rent or subscribe options, including large-scale systems.

listings.name: Amberfield College
listings.current_description: Amberfield College is a private school in Rooihuiskraal North, Centurion offering the IEB curriculum from Grade RRR to Grade 12; opened in 2019 and managed by Royal Schools, it now teaches around 1,770 learners with a focus on academics, sport and culture.

listings.name: Aroma Coffee Roastery & Gelato Shere Silverlakes
listings.current_description: Aroma Coffee Roastery & Gelato Shere Silverlakes is a branch of the Aroma Gourmet Coffee Roastery chain in the In Shere Centre, Silver Lakes, Pretoria, serving specialty roasted coffee, a fresh lunch menu and over fifty gelato flavours, including vegan and diabetic-friendly options.

listings.name: Astron Energy Amandelboom
listings.current_description: Astron Energy Amandelboom is a fuel station in Doornpoort, Pretoria, part of the Astron Energy network -- the brand that has been rebranding South Africa's former Caltex service stations since 2021, after Astron Energy took over the Caltex licence from Chevron in 2018.

listings.name: Astron Energy Annlin
listings.current_description: Astron Energy Annlin is a fuel station in Annlin, Pretoria, part of the Astron Energy network -- the brand that has been rebranding South Africa's former Caltex service stations since 2021, after Astron Energy took over the Caltex licence from Chevron in 2018.

listings.name: Astron Energy Eersterust
listings.current_description: Astron Energy Eersterust is a fuel station in Eersterust, Pretoria, part of the Astron Energy network -- the brand that has been rebranding South Africa's former Caltex service stations since 2021, after Astron Energy took over the Caltex licence from Chevron in 2018.

listings.name: Astron Energy Wonderpark
listings.current_description: Astron Energy Wonderpark is a fuel station in Karenpark, Akasia, part of the Astron Energy network -- the brand that has been rebranding South Africa's former Caltex service stations since 2021, after Astron Energy took over the Caltex licence from Chevron in 2018.
